description: L1 leading specifications: parametric statements over L0 objects.

specs.name: Successor law for addition

statement.math: For every natural number n, n + 1 = succ n.

leading_constraints: Addition is Nat.add; succ is Nat.succ.
excluded_generalizations: Other semirings, where 1 + 1 can differ from 2 (ZMod 2) or needs its own specification (ℤ, ℚ, ℝ).

specs.name: General Divisor Theorem (Theorem 3)

statement.math: If a is not admissible the accepted set is empty; otherwise Tmin is the minimal period and every run of Tmin consecutive integers holds exactly φ(R) accepted values; and φ(R)·N·φ(d) = d·R·φ(N).

leading_constraints: Single residue class n ≡ a (mod m); coprimality to one modulus N.
excluded_generalizations: Several simultaneous shifts (the multi-shift GDT, SPEC-multishift-gdt).

specs.name: Multi-shift General Divisor Theorem (count per period)

statement.math: For admissible (N, m, a, H), every run of Tmin consecutive integers holds exactly ∏_{p | R} (p − ν_p(H)) values n with n ≡ a (mod m) and gcd(n + h, N) = 1 for all h ∈ H.

leading_constraints: Moduli enter through the squarefree radical of N; independence across distinct primes (Chinese remainder theorem).
excluded_generalizations: Residue-class families with overlapping composite moduli (general covering systems): a count over the lcm period, outside this theorem.

specs.name: Prime pattern for an admissible shift set

statement.math: For an admissible H there are infinitely many integers n with n + h prime for every h ∈ H.
statement.lean: def PrimeTuple (H : Finset ℤ) : Prop := {n : ℤ | ∀ h ∈ H, BGP212.Gap.PrimeZ (n + h)}.Infinite

leading_constraints: Distinct integer shifts; admissibility is the only local obstruction.
excluded_generalizations: Shifts with leading coefficients other than 1 (Dickson, SPEC-dickson-linear).
specs.notes: Survey-local definition; it compiles once the survey project depends on lean-bgp212 (stage 4).

specs.name: DHL[k, m]

statement.math: For every admissible k-element H there are infinitely many n with at least m of the n + h prime.

leading_constraints: Quantifies over every admissible H of size k.
excluded_generalizations: Weighted or quantitative versions from the sieve literature.

specs.name: H₁ ≤ D

statement.math: Infinitely many consecutive primes differ by at most D.
statement.lean: def H1Le (D : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ᶠ n in atTop, primeGap n ≤ D

leading_constraints: Consecutive primes Nat.nth Nat.Prime; 'infinitely often' as Filter.Frequently atTop.
excluded_generalizations: Gaps between non-consecutive primes or in other sequences.

specs.name: Dickson's conjecture for linear forms

parameters.name: fs
parameters.domain: degree 1, positive leading coefficients, Schinzel condition

statement.math: A finite set of linear forms a·n + b with a > 0 and no fixed prime divisor takes simultaneously prime values at infinitely many natural n.

leading_constraints: Degree 1; positive leading coefficients; Schinzel condition.
specs.notes: Stated with sorry in formal-conjectures; the survey records the statement only.

specs.name: Admissible pairs of integer shifts

statement.math: {a, b} is admissible exactly when b − a is even. Modulo 2 both shifts must share one class; modulo a prime p ≥ 3 two shifts meet at most two of the p classes. Duplicate shifts (a = b) and negative integers are included.
statement.lean: theorem admissibleZ_pair_iff_even (a b : ℤ) : BGP212.Gap.AdmissibleZ ({a, b} : Finset ℤ) ↔ Even (b - a)

leading_constraints: Two shifts; the parity of b − a is the only local obstruction, arising at p = 2.
excluded_generalizations: Shift sets of any size: AdmissibleZ H ↔ for every prime p the reduction of H in ZMod p misses a class (the next target).
Shifts with leading coefficients other than 1 (Dickson, SPEC-dickson-linear).
specs.notes: Kernel-checked on the user's MBP against lean-bgp212 89b43fa (EV-0007). Comparator acceptance is a separate obligation.

specs.name: Admissibility as an omitted residue in ZMod p

statement.math: H is admissible exactly when for every prime p some residue r ∈ ZMod p lies outside residueImage p H.
statement.lean: theorem admissibleZ_iff_omits_residue (H : Finset ℤ) : BGP212.Gap.AdmissibleZ H ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ∃ r : ZMod p, r ∉ residueImage p H

leading_constraints: Residue bridge: (p : ℤ) ∣ h − r ↔ (h : ZMod p) = (r : ZMod p), valid for every modulus; an omitted residue r returns the integer ZMod.cast r.
excluded_generalizations: Composite moduli: admissibility quantifies over primes only.
specs.notes: Kernel-checked on the user's MBP against lean-bgp212 89b43fa (EV-0008). Comparator acceptance is a separate obligation.

specs.name: Admissibility as residue counting

statement.math: H is admissible exactly when for every prime p the shifts occupy fewer than p residue classes: (residueImage p H).card < p.
statement.lean: theorem admissibleZ_iff_card_lt (H : Finset ℤ) : BGP212.Gap.AdmissibleZ H ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (residueImage p H).card < p

leading_constraints: For prime p, ZMod p is finite with Fintype.card (ZMod p) = p (NeZero p from p.Prime); an omitted residue is a proper subset of Finset.univ.
excluded_generalizations: Comparison with the local factor ν_p(H) of the multi-shift GDT (OBJ-local-factor-nu), which counts the classes −h: the next connection.
specs.notes: Kernel-checked on the user's MBP against lean-bgp212 89b43fa (EV-0008). Comparator acceptance is a separate obligation.

specs.name: Conditional mean-zero cross-talk

statement.math: For any real separation function F, the uniform target-fiber conditional mean of crossTalk F equals zero, on the finite Boolean pattern product space.

leading_constraints: Finite neuron and memory types with decidable equality; patterns range over a finite Boolean product; fixed target coordinate fiber.
The statement holds for arbitrary F : ℝ → ℝ.
excluded_generalizations: Does not imply zero variance, Gaussian error estimates, or retrieval capacity.
specs.notes: RPI-2 reading from pinned DAM documentation; scope must be checked against exact Lean source for independent verification.

specs.name: Exact conditional expected one-flip gap

statement.math: The conditional target-fiber average of the one-flip energy gap for polyF n equals the exact signal N^n − (N−2)^n, for every n.

leading_constraints: Polynomial separation polyF n, finite Boolean pattern model, uniform target fiber.
Exact finite identity; no asymptotic size regime.
excluded_generalizations: Does not establish the large-N approximation, error probability, variance, or capacity scaling.
specs.notes: RPI-2 reading from pinned DAM documentation; scope must be checked against exact Lean source for independent verification.

specs.name: Finite second moment of the one-flip noise

statement.math: Determine and prove the exact finite conditional second moment (and resulting variance) of the noise/cross-talk term under the DAM finite uniform pattern model.

leading_constraints: Target-fiber conditional averaging over a finite Boolean product model.
Define the exact second-moment expression and account for repeated-index correlations.
excluded_generalizations: No claimed Lean proof, Gaussian approximation, or capacity theorem.
